item.title: MORAN ON ROTOR ACT
item.description: Just over a year has passed since a tragic crash at Reagan Airport in Washington D. C. claimed the lives of 67 people in an airplane that struck a military helicopter. Many of the people in the plane were from Kansas. Recently Senator Jerry Moran spoke about the steps taken to improve the safety in our skies, in particular, the ROTOR Act.
